acceptanceCriteria.criterion: GovernanceUser Model: Extends base User with governance fields
Role Enum: Owner, Admin, Contributor, Observer
Role Permissions Matrix: What each role can do
API Endpoint: GET /api/governance/users lists governance users
Permission Categories: vote, propose, amend, override, view
Permission Check: Decorator/middleware for role-gated endpoints
EscalationRule Model: Condition → escalate to higher authority
Escalation Triggers: Tie votes, quorum not met, constitutional conflict
Governance Gate: Connect to CSI thresholds from Story 8-8
Auto-Escalate: When system stability drops, require higher authority
Audit Trail: All role assignments and permission changes logged
